official_rules: https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/commander-legends-release-notes-2020-11-06 (cascade resolves before original; hit strictly lower printed mana value; caster may decline; original counter does not erase trigger)
Frozen graph data/grixis/graph/abaddon-the-despoiler.json for original nonland mana values and original card audit

registered_other_named_hand_spells: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
scope.zero_mv_extra_adversarial_example: Lotus Petal can have cascade when cast from hand while Abaddon is controlled, but cascade has no negative-mana-value hits: physically exile all library and put all back on bottom in random order; this can change library order but has no free spell.
causal_order: Only hand cast sources cast in own turn with Abaddon already on battlefield at cast check qualify; own life-loss does not count, use aggregate opponents lost THIS TURN before casting.
Printed mana value, not generic cost after discounts, determines cascade trigger threshold.

Source-paid spell moves from physical hand onto stack, Birgi red spell-cast trigger if already controlled before cast; cascade exiles first legal strictly-lower MV physical hit and resolves optional fixed 12-effect subset before source resolves.
Boltwave and Flame Rift can raise opponent-loss threshold ONLY when original spell resolves after its possible cascade trigger, not retroactively before.

Other hand spell source cannot target itself as a permanent before it resolves; the only guaranteed stack spell during cascade is the original; supported hit fixed safe policy assumes registered legal targets.
Free exile spell does not gain Abaddon hand-only cascade; Birgi may grant red cast trigger if controlled.
Cards exiled and not cast are put at library bottom in seeded random order. Original no-other-cascade policy must call unchanged previous simulator.
MV0 hand spell cascade mandatory trigger can churn entire physical deck, but cannot have a <0 hit; no infinite loops.
scope.notes: Because base pilot ignores all but eight named hand-spell actions, even this extension does NOT model the other 90+ possible hand spells or all combat/ETB/stack outcomes.

adversarial_tests: Boltwave cannot grant its own cascade from damage it deals when resolving; must already have >=1 opponent loss at cast.
Flame Rift requires >=2 life loss BEFORE cast and source MV2 can hit MV0 or MV1, but not MV2.
Rakdos MV4 hits first nonland MV0-3 and physical extra hit may resolve before creature enters.
Nightscape Familiar MV2 hits only MV0/1, even if generic costs reduced.
Mana-value zero hand spell generates a mandatory cascade exile of full remaining library and zero free cast.
Birgi spell on stack does not grant its own red trigger; existing controlled Birgi does trigger on later hand and exile casts.
Commander Abaddon itself is cast from command zone and does NOT receive its own hand-only cascade.
No cascade from physical spell cast from exile through Abaddon hand-only static ability.
Original first_cascade/first-main policy without opt-in must remain unchanged and pass 20 existing shared-state cases.
Every conditional simulator trajectory conserves full physical 99 cards in exact zones.
No opponent disruption probabilities, actual games, measured win rate, deck changes or M6/M7 certification.
